crowhrFixtureNotes: Copied from research/sg-test-vectors.json (generatedOn 2026-10-31). Two vectors were corrected after the independent verification in research/verification/codex-verification.md; see packages/sg-rules/VERIFICATION.md.

AW-11: June AW payable is 0. The $40,000 is earlier AW (Feb-May) newly subjected on the last-month recomputation, modelled as inputs.awHistory + ytdOwSubjectCents + employmentLastMonth. expected.total/employee/employer remain the month's CPF including that shortfall; expected.currentMonth and expected.priorAwShortfall split it. SDL is on June wages only ($1,500): $3.75.
SPR-04: 2028 CPF tables are not published. Expected rate table is 2027:T1 carried forward, with ratesAssumedCarriedForward = true.

CALC-*: the 15 cases confirmed in CPF Board's public CPF contribution calculator on 31 Oct 2026 (VERIFICATION.md "CPF calculator check"), provenance OFFICIAL_CALCULATOR.
